grammarFocus: 名词单复数、拼写、数字和大小写；问句结构复查。
title: Timed Listening and Accurate Note-Taking in Academic Settings
prompt: In many university courses, students are expected to listen to spoken information — lectures, seminars, and everyday conversations — under time pressure and to record it accurately for later use. Some educators argue that the ability to take reliable notes while listening is now a more valuable academic skill than memorising content, and that universities should therefore teach and assess note-taking explicitly. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this view? In your essay, state your position clearly, discuss at least two reasons or examples that support your view, and consider one counter-argument before reaching a justified conclusion. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟雅思学术类写作 Task 2 练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。建议先用 2–3 分钟审题：明确题目要求你表达对“大学应显性教授并评估听力中的准确记录能力”这一观点的同意程度，并确认需包含至少两个理由或例子以及一个反方观点。写作时保持清晰立场，每个主体段围绕一个中心论点展开，并用具体但虚构的学术场景（如讲座、研讨课、日常对话）加以说明。注意控制在 40 分钟内完成，字数不少于 250 词，写完后预留几分钟检查连贯性与任务回应是否完整。
